_note: DATA. `requires` BLOCKS interpretation when a member is absent from the same batch; `recommends` never blocks. The split is the decision recorded in ADR-003.
_naming: `aliases` declares NAMES, not spellings. engine/analyte-name.js folds case, word order, punctuation and parenthetical decoration, so `Total Testosterone` already covers `Testosterone, Total`, `total testosterone` and `Total testosterone (T)`. A TRANSLATION is not a spelling and cannot be derived, so each language is declared once — which is why the Russian name this package's own README and role file use is listed here. QE F3 (MEASURED 2026-08-05) found it missing and the value walking straight past the gate. `requires_aliases` does the same job for the COMPANION side: the role file's BLOCK row spells the companion «ГСПГ (SHBG)», and a batch reporting ГСПГ must satisfy `requires: ['SHBG']`.

effect.consequence: a near-miss replacement-therapy discussion built on a probable artefact — total testosterone without SHBG cannot separate a binding-protein shift from a true change in the free fraction
